file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 GCC 13 build, stripped to external PDB

injection_details.method: APC queue injection (early-bird style): NtQueueApcThread + NtAlertResumeThread on a suspended thread
injection_details.target_process: self (own process; PID obtained via GetCurrentProcessId)
injection_details.target_discovery: Opens own process with NtOpenProcess (access 0x42A = PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD|PROCESS_VM_OPERATION|PROCESS_VM_WRITE|PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION), then enumerates system threads with CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD=4)/Thread32First/Thread32Next, picks the first thread whose th32OwnerProcessID == own PID, opens it with OpenThread(0x12 = THREAD_SET_CONTEXT|THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME) and suspends it with SuspendThread
injection_details.payload_write: 48-byte shellcode (RC4-decrypted from .data:0x140004000) written into self via NtAllocateVirtualMemory(MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE=0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40) followed by NtWriteVirtualMemory; the allocation base is queued as the APC routine and the suspended thread is resumed in alertable state with NtAlertResumeThread, executing the shellcode; process then calls Sleep(500)

encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (standard KSA at 0x140001480, PRGA/XOR at 0x140001573; 256-byte S-box followed by i counter at +0x100 and j counter at +0x104)
encryption_details.key_storage: plaintext, hardcoded in .rdata section at VA 0x140005000 (start of section)

decoded_strings.note: The only encrypted content is a 48-byte (0x30) blob at .data:0x140004000 which RC4-decrypts (key 4a8c1fd367e92b05cafe77339d125e88) to the shellcode that is APC-injected into the process's own suspended thread.
